scope: Real IndexedDB and native SVG rendering; isolated synthetic in-memory server, no production account/provider calls.
browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
passed: Legacy inventory is read-only and reports HTML, images, conversions and saved colors.
Migration preserves IDs, sources, saved SVG/color, folders/favorites and is idempotent.
No-op stage cleanup and interrupted publication retain honest, explicitly retryable state.
Two independent client revisions conflict honestly; explicit retry preserves both independent edits.
Only the importing device runs its queue; completed SVGs publish and receive a fresh native pixel check.
Hidden cloud roots refresh locally without republishing curated source files.
Logout fences queued work, aborts publication and keeps recoverable staged inputs across sign-in.
Original browser databases remain byte-for-byte inventoried and untouched.
captureMethod: Read the completed visible DOM report in the supported cloud browser. No hidden application state or browser network APIs used.
